slot_scores.name: purchase_at_month_start
slot_scores.evidence_quote: For the warehouse capacity limit of 500 units, is this a maximum inventory level that must be respected at the end of each month, or is it a maximum that applies to the inventory level at any point during the month (including mid-month)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent probed intra-month timing of the capacity/inventory constraint, which is related, but never explicitly asked when purchases occur within the month (start vs end), so the specific purchase-timing meaning of H1 was not covered.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Purchases occur within the month such that only the end-of-month inventory balance matters (aggregate balance I_m = I_{m-1} + P_m - S_m), with no distinct intra-month purchase timing.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked when purchases are made relative to sales and simply encoded an aggregate monthly balance without confirming purchase timing.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 purchase-timing slot was only partially addressed and not explicitly confirmed.

summary: The agent clarified the objective, capacity meaning, limits, integrality, and final-inventory rules well, but never explicitly confirmed when purchases occur within a month, leaving the P1 purchase-timing slot partially resolved and silently assumed in the final model.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
